insights.title: Cooling drives the summer bill
insights.detail: Above 19.5 °C each extra degree adds about 0.6 kWh/day. A 10% cut in cooling energy saves about 53 kWh/year.

insights.title: Evening peak
insights.detail: The top 10% of hours use 21% of energy; moving 15% of that load off-peak shifts about 77 kWh/year (a saving only under time-of-use pricing).

insights.title: Always-on base load
insights.detail: The 5th-percentile power is 58 W, about 508 kWh/year (20% of use). Trimming 20% of it saves about 102 kWh/year.

insights.title: Weekend effect
insights.detail: Average weekend day 6.8 kWh vs weekday 6.9 kWh.
